description: Epoch AI 'Machine Learning Hardware' dataset — AI accelerators with performance (FLOP/s by precision), memory, bandwidth, TDP, price, process node.

body.columns_note: 39 columns total; key ones listed. See CSV header for the full set of precision/clock variants.
body.how_to_read: One row per accelerator (GPUs/TPUs/etc). 'Release price (USD)', 'TDP (W)', 'Memory (bytes)', and the FLOP/s columns support price-performance, power, and memory-content context for AI chips.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'Machine Learning Hardware' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
